column3: The Hebrew presents thanking and recounting as completed; BSB uses present verbs and explicitly supplies the people.
The Hebrew describes melting and completed establishing of pillars; BSB says quake and bear up.
The Hebrew presents the speech as completed; BSB uses I say.
The Hebrew says on high rather than explicitly against heaven.
The Hebrew names a mixture without explicitly naming spices.
The Hebrew leaves the object of proclaiming unnamed; BSB supplies Him.
The Hebrew describes the righteous one’s horns rising rather than explicitly being exalted by another.
